newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Khoza named as S.Africa's new Eskom chairman.
newsitem.headline: Khoza named as S.Africa's new Eskom chairman.

text.p: Reuel Khoza is to be the new chairman of South African electricity parastatal Eskom from March 15, minister for public enterprises Stella Sigcau said on Wednesday.
Khoza replaces John Maree who will retire the day before Khoza takes up the post.
Sigcau paid tribute to Maree's work, saying Eskom was the lowest-cost producer of electricity in the world and connecting up more than 1,000 homes a day to South Africa's electricity grid.
Eskom has recently moved into the market spotlight as South Africa's privatisation drive gains momentum following the annoucement of a strategic equity partner for telecommunications giant Telkom.
